ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Percentage of completed Risk Aversion choices in which the participant selected the 50/50 gamble.
Notes: Primary behavioral outcome reported in the paper.

ElementDescription: Natural-log transformed alpha risk-preference parameter from the fitted Risk Aversion choice model.
Notes: Primary model-derived outcome analyzed in the paper. Higher underlying alpha indicates greater willingness to take risk.

ElementDescription: Tjur coefficient of discrimination from the Risk Aversion response-quality model.
Notes: Study quality-control measure. Risk Aversion data were discarded when Tjur <0.20.

ElementDescription: Percentage of completed Kable 51-item Intertemporal Choice trials in which the participant selected the larger delayed reward.
Notes: Primary behavioral outcome reported in the paper.

ElementDescription: Natural-log transformed hyperbolic discount-rate parameter k estimated from the Kable 51-item Intertemporal Choice task.
Notes: Primary model-derived outcome analyzed in the paper. Higher underlying k indicates stronger preference for immediate rewards and greater delay discounting.

ElementDescription: Tjur coefficient of discrimination from the Kable 51-item Intertemporal Choice response-quality model.
Notes: Study quality-control measure. Intertemporal Choice data were discarded when Tjur <0.20.
